metadata.question: Between October 2021 and November 2021, did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than northern Ethiopia relative its long-term average for the same months from 2000 to 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY). Compare Oct–Nov 2021 precipitation against the long-term mean of Oct–Nov for 2000–2013 over Ethiopia. Split Ethiopia into north/south by its centroid latitude. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking; CHIRPS is already gap-filled precipitation. Use geographic masks for north/south within Ethiopia. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - C1 if the 2021 or baseline collection is empty. - C2 if valid pixels after masking are zero in either region. - C3 if any computed value is null/NaN or baseline mean <= 0 (invalid reference). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const ethi = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Ethiopia')) .geometry(); const latImg = ee.Image.pixelLonLat().select('latitude'); const midLat = ethi.centroid(1).coordinates().get(1); const countryMask = ee.Image.constant(1).clip(ethi).gt(0); const start2021 = '2021-10-01'; const end2021 = '2021-12-01'; const baseStart = '2000-10-01'; const baseEnd = '2013-12-01'; const scale = 5500; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); const col2021 = chirps.filterDate(start2021, end2021).filterBounds(ethi); const n2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); if (n2021 === 0) { console.log('2021 Images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } const colBaseline = chirps.filterDate(baseStart, baseEnd).filterBounds(ethi); const nBaseImgs = colBaseline.size().getInfo(); if (nBaseImgs === 0) { console.log('Baseline Images (2000-2013 Oct-Nov): 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2013); const yearlySums = ee.ImageCollection(years.map(function(y) { y = ee.Number(y); const sumY = chirps .filterDate(ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 10, 1), ee.Date.fromYMD(y, 12, 1)) .filterBounds(ethi) .sum() .rename('precip'); return sumY.set('year', y); })); const baselineMeanImg = yearlySums.mean().rename('precip'); const sum2021Img = col2021.sum().rename('precip'); // 3. Processing: masks and pixel counts const northMask = countryMask.and(latImg.gt(midLat)); const southMask = countryMask.and(latImg.lte(midLat)); const sum2021North = sum2021Img.updateMask(northMask); const sum2021South = sum2021Img.updateMask(southMask); const baseNorth = baselineMeanImg.updateMask(northMask); const baseSouth = baselineMeanImg.updateMask(southMask); const count2021North = sum2021North.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: ethi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('precip').getInfo(); const count2021South = sum2021South.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: ethi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('precip').getInfo(); if (!count2021North || !count2021South || count2021North === 0 || count2021South === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels 2021 (north/south): ${count2021North || 0} / ${count2021South || 0}`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation: area-summed totals and anomalies const sum2021NorthTot = sum2021North.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: ethi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('precip').getInfo(); const sum2021SouthTot = sum2021South.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: ethi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('precip').getInfo(); const baseNorthTot = baseNorth.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: ethi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('precip').getInfo(); const baseSouthTot = baseSouth.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: ethi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e13 }).get('precip').getInfo(); const nums = [sum2021NorthTot, sum2021SouthTot, baseNorthTot, baseSouthTot]; const invalid = nums.some(v => v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v)); if (invalid || baseNorthTot <= 0 || baseSouthTot <= 0) { console.log('Calculation invalid (null/NaN or baseline<=0).'); console.log('C3'); return; } const anomN = sum2021NorthTot - baseNorthTot; const anomS = sum2021SouthTot - baseSouthTot; const pctN = (sum2021NorthTot / baseNorthTot - 1) * 100.0; const pctS = (sum2021SouthTot / baseSouthTot - 1) * 100.0; // 5. Evidence prints (<=20 lines) console.log(`CHIRPS Oct-Nov 2021 images: ${n2021}`); console.log(`Baseline years (2000-2013): ${years.size().getInfo()} | Daily imgs: ${nBaseImgs}`); console.log(`Valid pixels 2021 (north/south): ${count2021North} / ${count2021South}`); console.log(`North: 2021 total(mm)=${sum2021NorthTot.toFixed(0)}, Clim mean(mm)=${baseNorthTot.toFixed(0)}, Anom(mm)=${anomN.toFixed(0)}, Anom(%)=${pctN.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`South: 2021 total(mm)=${sum2021SouthTot.toFixed(0)}, Clim mean(mm)=${baseSouthTot.toFixed(0)}, Anom(mm)=${anomS.toFixed(0)}, Anom(%)=${pctS.toFixed(1)}`); // 6. Final Answer // Question: Did southern Ethiopia receive less rainfall than northern Ethiopia relative to its long-term average? // Interpretation: Yes if anomaly_south < anomaly_north (more negative). const answer = (anomS < anomN) ? 'A' : 'B'; console.log(answer); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
